markets.trend: Sustained, near-record mainland southbound buying of HK equities over the past year; the single confirmed daily data point (1 Sep, +HK$7.76bn) is consistent with that trend, though no reading closer to 11 Sep was retrieved.
markets.interpretation: For a book heavy in HK tech, persistent southbound buying (Tencent, Alibaba and other internet/tech names are perennial southbound favorites) is a structurally supportive flow backdrop. markets.trend: Chinese retail/margin-driven risk appetite has run hot through most of 2026 (record margin balances, elevated turnover), consistent with a strong onshore rally narrative. Foreign (northbound) participation is now largely opaque in real time.
markets.interpretation: For a book heavy in HK tech: sustained mainland retail leverage and southbound buying (see Hong Kong entry) form a supportive flow backdrop for HK-listed tech/internet names funded by mainland money. But a record margin balance is also a classic late-cycle/froth signal -- a reversal in mainland retail sentiment (forced margin-call deleveraging) is a tail risk worth flagging for HK tech exposure specifically.

Margin balance and new-account-opening data are the standard proxies, and even margin-balance figures are reported inconsistently across outlets. Northbound real-time flow disclosure has been discontinued since Aug 2024; only lagged monthly aggregates remain, none retrieved this session.
